src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/A.name: Currency lock check
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/A.description: Asks the other parts of the app whether any recorded amounts already use the farm's current currency.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/A.name: Farm setup service
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/A.description: Carries out farm-level requests such as reading and saving settings, logo, banner and connected apps.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/A.name: Farm account storage
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/A.description: Describes how the app loads and saves the farm's own settings record.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/A.name: Currency lock rule
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/A.description: States the rule that the farm currency can only change while no recorded amounts depend on the current one.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/A.name: Money-holding table marker
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/A.description: Marks one kind of record that may hold an amount in the farm currency, so it gets counted by the currency check.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/A.name: Logo and banner storage
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/A.description: Describes how the farm's logo and banner pictures are loaded and saved, fetching only as much as each caller needs.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/A.name: Remove farm logo
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/A.description: Clears the farm's logo so the app falls back to its own default branding.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/A.name: Switch connected apps
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/A.description: Turns the farm's permission for connected apps on or off, refusing the change if someone else saved settings first.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/A.name: Connected apps check
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/A.description: Checks that a connected-apps change actually says on or off.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/A.name: Upload farm banner
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/A.description: Accepts a new or replacement banner picture after cleaning and checking it.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/A.name: Upload farm logo
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/A.description: Accepts a new or replacement logo picture after cleaning and checking it.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/A.name: Save farm settings
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/A.description: Saves the farm's settings as a whole, refusing the save if someone else changed them in the meantime or if the currency is locked.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/A.name: Farm settings check
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/A.description: Checks the farm's settings are valid before saving, such as name, time zone, currency and units.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/C.name: Branding fingerprints
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/C.description: Holds short fingerprints of the logo and banner so the app can tell when they have changed.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/C.name: Logo picture data
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/C.description: Bundles the logo or banner picture bytes with its format.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/C.name: Logo details
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/C.description: Holds the facts about a logo or banner (format, size, version) without the picture itself.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/C.name: Farm settings limits
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/C.description: Holds the shared limits for farm settings, such as allowed lengths and values.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/C.name: Farm directory
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/C.description: Lists every farm with its time zone, for behind-the-scenes tasks that run outside any one farm's login.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/C.name: Farm test data access
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/C.description: Reads and writes sample farm data for the simulation setup; not available in production.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/C.name: Farm setup contract
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/C.description: Lists everything the rest of the app can ask the farm area to do, such as read or change settings and branding.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/C.name: Connected apps request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/C.description: The request to allow or block connected apps; leaving the choice out is an error.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/C.name: Farm settings request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Farm/C.description: The full set of farm settings sent when the owner saves the settings page.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Accoun.name: Farm account
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Accoun.description: The farm's own settings record: name, time zone, currency, units, branding choices and connected-apps switch.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Accoun.name: Farm colour themes
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Accoun.description: The fixed list of accent colour palettes a farm can pick for its look.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Accoun.name: Farm logo and banner
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Accoun.description: Stores the farm's logo and banner pictures.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Accoun.name: Unit system
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Accoun.description: The choice of measurement units (such as metric or imperial) used to show feed, water and weights.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Accoun.name: User role assignment
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Accoun.description: Records which role a person has on the farm and whether it is limited to certain flocks.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Contra.name: Currency list
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Contra.description: A built-in list of world currencies with their symbols and decimal places, used when picking the farm currency.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Contra.name: Currency details
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Contra.description: The facts about one currency, such as its code and decimal places.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Contra.name: Effective role
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Contra.description: Works out a person's working role; only a plain worker is ever limited to particular flocks.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Contra.name: Farm code
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Contra.description: The short lowercase, web-safe code that identifies a farm; it is always stored in cleaned-up form.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Contra.name: Picture size errors
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Contra.description: The messages given when an uploaded logo or banner is too large, before it is examined.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Contra.name: Role names
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Contra.description: The one place where the names of user roles are defined.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Contra.name: Starting-data IDs
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Contra.description: Fixed IDs for the single sample farm created when the app is first set up.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Contra.name: Worker sale stock rule
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Contra.description: Says how a restricted worker's sale confirmation may draw on egg stock.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Media/.name: Picture formats
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Media/.description: The picture formats a logo or banner may be saved in.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Media/.name: Picture cleaner
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Media/.description: Checks an uploaded logo or banner and rejects anything too large or malformed, naming which picture failed.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Media/.name: Picture cleaner (JPEG)
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Media/.description: The JPEG part of the picture cleaner: checks the file's structure and strips hidden metadata and trailing extras.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Media/.name: Picture cleaner (PNG)
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Farm/Media/.description: The PNG part of the picture cleaner: checks the file's structure and strips hidden metadata and trailing extras.
